section_summary.extract_value: This discussion reports psychometric support for a one-dimensional Arabic-translated BAS-2 and evidence of internal consistency and convergent validity in a single convenience sample. The sample consisted of young adult female university attendees in the UAE (college student sample), BMI was self-reported, and the correlation between body appreciation and BMI was negative but not statistically significant.
